title: Merge Sorted Event Streams
prerequisite: Two-pointer reasoning from Lesson 5. ListNode is supplied.
hints: Because both lists are sorted, the smallest remaining node must be at the head of one of the two remaining lists.
Keep a tail pointer for the merged list, attach the smaller current node, and advance only the list that supplied it.
An optional sentinel simplifies the head case; when one list ends, attach the entire remainder of the other list.
